title: Claude Code Global User Configuration
description: Global user configuration/state file for Claude Code CLI. Current builds prefer ~/.claude/.config.json and fall back to legacy ~/.claude.json. This schema models the persisted global file (auth state, UI preferences, caches, usage counters, IDs, and nested per-project state) and intentionally excludes separately merged settings.json/project/policy configuration.
$comment: Reverse-engineered from cli.unpack.js v2.1.113 using DEFAULT_GLOBAL_CONFIG (ha() at line 161601, assigned to qN_ at line 162412), GLOBAL_CONFIG_KEYS (Hoq at line 162413), PROJECT_CONFIG_KEYS (_oq at line 162414), project defaults (pkH at line 162401), NOTIFICATION_CHANNELS (ay_ at line 161563), EDITOR_MODES (sy_ at line 161564), TEAMMATE_MODES (arq at line 161565), theme enum (dl4 at line 191724 via another module), MCP transport types (bL3 at line 61299). Previously based on v2.1.104 (lo/r84/o84/Ho6) and an earlier v2.1.112 cut (La/uk8/Lq4/hq4/rk6/Sk8/Ck8/Nq4/Au_/C5O).
